# ChessStream Africa

Live chess broadcasting platform for African tournaments and federations. The broadcasting arm of Prochess Academy.

## Features
- Real-time chess broadcasts from Lichess
- Per-board chat and commentary threads
- Engine-evaluation based move commentary (per-tournament configurable)
- Live standings with configurable tiebreak systems (Sonneborn-Berger, Buchholz, Direct Encounter, Most Wins)
- Qualification scenario panels
- Player search and head-to-head records
- Admin-attached live stream links per board or tournament
- Game analyzer with PGN import
- Daily chess puzzles

## API
- Player search: /api/search?q=NAME
- Head-to-head: /api/search?q=NAME1+vs+NAME2
- Broadcasts: /api/lichess/broadcasts
- Round games: /api/lichess/round/ROUND_ID
- Per-board chat: /api/chat/GAME_ID
- Tournament config: /api/config?tournament=ID
- Stream links: /api/streams?tournament=ID
- FIDE stats: /api/fide/stats?id1=ID&id2=ID
